oneLineCopy: Your calendar plans around your life — not the other way round.

hero.headlineSerifLead: Meetings, travel, buffers and the hours you actually build in — laid out so the day keeps what it promises.

founderScenario.story: Three meetings back to back, all confirmed, none with travel time. The second is 22 minutes away, the third a call Daniel would have needed an hour to prepare for. At 7:41 am he already knows he'll be late today — and that the work he founded a company for won't happen. Again.

benefits: Travel and prep time is in the calendar before you forget it
Your deep-work blocks get defended, not sacrificed first
Meeting requests get proposals that fit the day you actually have
Conflicts surface while they're still solvable — not the morning before
What's private stays private: your calendar lives with you, not with a corporation
howSteps: A meeting arrives — by mail, by invite, or from a conversation with your Aven
Your Aven checks location, travel, preparation and what the day already holds
It books the buffer, the travel and the prep with it — or proposes a better slot
On real conflicts it asks you; everything else it sorts quietly

whatMechanics.input: Calendar feeds, invites from email manager, tasks from todo shuffler, contacts from brain memorizer
whatMechanics.magic: Travel-time estimation → buffer and prep rules → conflict detection → focus-block protection → propose, never overrule
whatMechanics.output: A day that adds up · proposals for incoming requests · defended focus blocks

playsWith.relation: Invites from mail land in the right slot
Whatever is due today gets real time in the calendar
Who you're meeting — and what was last discussed
Moves that hurt are confirmed by you

valueStack.timeDelayToValue: The first day is planned as soon as your calendar is connected
valueStack.effortToInstall: Connect the calendar, state your working hours — done
valueStack.proof: Still in the workshop: calendar organizer runs in our own days before it runs in yours.

bonuses: Travel days: routes, buffers and overnight stays are planned in
Morning briefing: what's coming today and what you need for it
Quiet hours: evenings and weekends are not meeting slots by default
letterFromPublisher: A calendar that only shows appointments is a list of things happening to you. Daniel lived inside that list for years. I'm building the opposite: a day shaped around the person living it — including the hours where nobody wants anything from you.
